abilities.name: Framing: Freezing Point Composition

variants.label: Focused Impression (Hold)
_curatorNotes: Hold cast (Focused Impression). input:['hE'] added 2026-07-15 — was previously the unreachable input-less 'Finisher Frame Cast' (cooldown only, no frames). gcsim skillHoldCD=1080f=18s (base Press = 720f = 12s). Frames = skillHoldFrames at min hold (hold=1): swap=134+1, N=132+1, E/Q=130+1; the hold parameter adds a variable offset, D/J stay at the InitAbilSlice 137 default (omitted per recipe). Hold cooldownStartDelay is parametric (hitmark-2) — AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field (see [[curator-notes-deferral-survey]]).
behavior changed from generator-stub 'stance' to 'instant'. Charlotte's Composition Mode (Hold) is a caster aiming state — normals/charge are NOT replaced. Not a stance per recipe table.
generator-stub 'duration: 15' removed. That value was the Composition Mode max hold time (not an entity lifetime); no summons[] authored for the marks (see below).
Press frames authored as base 'frames'. Press cooldownStartDelay = 29f (skillPressDelay from gcsim).

Hold variant has variable frame duration: gcsim total animation = hold + skillHoldFrames[next], where hold is a runtime parameter (range 1–809f, min hitmark = hold+111). Post-release cancel frames (min hold=1): swap=134+1=135, N=132+1=133, Q=130+1=131, E=130+1=131; D and J default to AnimationLength (137+1=138) — not real cancels. Hold cooldownStartDelay is also variable: hitmark-2 = (hold+111)-2 = hold+109 (minimum ~110f).

Snappy Silhouette and Focused Impression marks are enemy-targeted periodic DMG sources (AttackTagElementalArt, ICDTagCharlotteMark / ICDGroupCharlotteMark), ticking every 90f (1.5s). Not spawned entities — not modeled as summons[]. Reviewer to decide representation. Press mark: 360+48=408f (~6.8s); Hold mark: 720+54=774f (~12.9s).

'heal' tag removed 2026-07-12: E is damage/marking only — no heal anywhere in gcsim skill.go or kit text. The tag was a mis-tag from the A1 tag batch (heals attached to Charlotte's kit all originate from the burst; even C6's coordinated heal is burst-attributed despite triggering off E's Focused Impression mark).

abilities.name: Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation
_curatorNotes: Heal effects authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10: Cast Healing 461.8% ATK + 3539 (instant, all party members, on cast) + Kamera Continuous Regeneration 16.6% ATK + 126 per tick (active character within the field only). Targets verified against gcsim burst.go: initial heal uses Target: -1 (whole party); dot heal targets c.Core.Player.Active() gated on IsWithinArea(healAP) — hence target: active, not team. Kit text agrees ('all nearby party members' / 'active character(s) within its AoE').

Tick cadence from gcsim burstTickFrames = [95, 119, 143, 166, 179, 203, 226, 249] (cast-relative; field spawns at 53f). Dominant interval 24f = 0.4s with one irregular 13f gap (166→179); authored as interval 0.4 / firstTickDelay 0.7 (95-53 = 42f). Actual tick count is 8; the regularized cadence renders 9 within the 4s window — accepted approximation.
ATK and Healing Bonus snapshot at cast for both the initial heal and all dot ticks (gcsim takes one Snapshot and computes heal/healDot from it before queuing).

Kamera also deals periodic Cryo DMG on the same tick frames (Kamera DMG 11.6% ATK at TL10, ICDTagCharlotteKamera); damage ticks not authored — heal-focused pass. C1 Verification heal-over-time rides on these heal events (see constellation node).
